channel.title: Togo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Togo, every source cited.

item.title: African consumers urge zero added sugar for young children
item.description: The African Consumers Organisation (OAC) is pushing for new international standards to remove added sugars from infant foods.

item.title: Togo journalist's judicial control challenged
item.description: The Union of African Free Press Journalists demands an end to restrictions on veteran reporter Apollinaire Mèwènèmesse K.

item.title: Togo party welcomes ECOWAS court letter on constitutional order
item.description: The Santé du Peuple party urged a swift return to the 1992 constitution, rejecting academic discussions.

item.title: Lokossa school denies intimate video rumour
item.description: CEG 3 administration states the student named in viral social media posts is not enrolled.

item.title: Lycée Adidogomé 1 beats Lycée Zébévi in Génie Imhotep
item.description: Adidogomé 1 scored 410 points to defeat Zébévi's 370 in the third season of the 'Génie Imhotep' quiz competition.
